timeout.description: Timeout is the maximum amount of time to wait for the shell step to complete. If unset, consumers should apply their default shell step timeout.

maxExecutionTime.description: Max execution time duration (e.g., PT30M, PT1H).

payloadProperties.description: Arbitrary key-value payload parameters for the Geneva Action operation.

operation.description: Specifies the type of Pav2 operation to run via Geneva Actions.

rolloutKind.description: Specifies the type of log rollout configuration. Different rollout kinds have different required fields and validation rules.

oneOf.description: Log configuration from Fluent Bit source
ARO Classic RP Log configuration from RP VMSS
ARO Classic Cluster Log configuration from ARO Clusters

eventSources.description: A map of event configurations where keys represent the fluent bit tag and values are their corresponding Geneva Event config. Refer to https://eng.ms/docs/products/geneva/collect/instrument/linux/fluentd for details

^.*$.description: Geneva Event configuration for the corresponding fluent bit tag

name.description: The name of the Geneva table for this event source.

account.description: The name of the geneva account for this event source. If not specified, the default account will be used.

environment.description: Optional ARO-HCP environment (for example int, stg or prod) used to scope Kusto cluster discovery so each environment gets an isolated entity group.

not.description: SafeFly steps are generated from an entrypoint opt-in, not authored.
